first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public Historic England NHLE v02 Listed Building polygons feature payload for the Exeter envelope 288000,88000,298000,99000 (EPSG:27700), with physical Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry directly bound in the same feature to ListEntry/Name/Grade type-use evidence. The current official FeatureServer exposes layer 3 as Listed Building polygons and Historic England reports the polygon data updated 6 October 2026, but the selected first-50 Exeter query payload was not retrievable through the available web channel and direct no-login network resolution failed at DNS before any feature coordinates or attributes were read; no geometry or record was inferred or fabricated, so no individual building record was accepted.
